title: Efficient Computation of QKD Key Rates without Semidefinite Programming
summary: Translating observed data into a reliable estimate of the secure key rate is a crucial step for operating a quantum key distribution device. We provide a computational method for this task that only requires eigenvalue computations and is therefore both fast and resource efficient. In contrast, existing approaches rely on semidefinite programming or programming on the entropy cone, whose memory requirements can scale as $d^4$ in the underlying Hilbert-space dimension.
